decisions.reason: The orientation flexibility applies to the integrated single-board layout, not the separate modular power board whose enclosure-fit constraints remain unchanged.
The source concerns the integrated board and does not revise the separate modular main board's vertical rail mounting or connector-placement requirements.
The integrated-board orientation choice does not change the separate sensor board's vertical mounting and connector-access requirements.
Permitting horizontal orientation for the integrated board does not necessarily change the modular power board's battery-connector placement, clearance, or spacing.
Board orientation flexibility has no effect on component sourceability, cost, or JLCPCB part-selection policies.
The mechanical orientation decision does not alter the integrated board's electrical battery, USB, charging, or power-rail behavior.
Allowing either board orientation does not change the ESP32 module model, breakout access, style, placement flexibility, or pitch.
The source makes no change to I2C cable, pull-up, bus-speed, or signal-conditioning requirements.
The source addresses the integrated board's physical orientation and does not revise the historical modular interboard connector topology or pinouts.
The statement preserves the ability to mount the display on an opposite face and does not necessarily change the enclosure's display cutout, mounting, airflow, assembly, or retention requirements.
Mechanical board orientation does not change any ESP32-S3 GPIO availability or signal assignment.
The orientation flexibility does not alter the panel-mounted button's connector, signal connection, or power-control behavior.
